名字簿被紅影抹去一行，河岸卻還有人沒能撤進神殿。莎爾瑪停下補寫，轉向巴絲特。: A red shadow erased a line from the book of names, but people on the riverbank still had not reached the temple. Salma stopped writing and turned to Bastet.
這邊還過不去。隼翼的力量交給妳，先帶他們進門。: We still cannot get through here. Take the falcon's strength and bring them inside first.
妳指方向，我開路。那個空格等人平安，再問他自己。: Point the way, and I will clear it. Once they are safe, we can ask them about that blank space ourselves.
巴絲特突破河岸的阻攔，人群走進神殿。莎爾瑪在圖上記下他們的落腳處。: Bastet broke through the blockade at the riverbank, and the crowd entered the temple. Salma marked their shelter on the map.
人到了。那個名字，我等本人親口告訴我。: They made it. I will wait for that person to tell me their name.

好。人群還要從這裡走，妳守著他們。: All right. People still need this way through. Stay with them.
守門符在下一波攻勢中發動，巴絲特接下戰鬥，擊退了莎米拉。: The guardian talisman activated during the next assault. Bastet took the battle and drove Samira back.
剛才回頭，門還在。這一次沒把接應丟掉。: When I looked back, the door was still there. This time I did not leave our support behind.

不要把唯一伏兵用在第一位較弱敵方。: Do not spend your only Ambush on the first, weaker enemy.
熟悉的呼喊從一側逼近，莉姆與莎米拉卻先後攻來。莎爾瑪望向聲音，又看回巴絲特。: A familiar call came from one side, while Reem and Samira attacked in turn. Salma looked toward the voice, then back at Bastet.
莉姆這一下我接。守門符留給後面，更強的那個。: I can take Reem's hit. Save the guardian talisman for the stronger one behind her.
那我守住門，不追聲音。妳需要的時候叫我。: Then I will hold the door and not follow the voice. Call when you need me.
兩次戰鬥落定，守門符用在後方那一擊。巴絲特仍留在門前。: Both battles ended. The talisman had stopped the later strike, and Bastet still stood at the gate.
我還想回頭找那聲音。: I still want to turn back and find that voice.
等這裡的人站穩，我陪妳問。先別一個人追。: Once everyone here is safe, I will go ask with you. Just do not chase it alone yet.

5星需要一份祭品。: A Level 5 Normal Summon needs 1 Tribute.
回收只到手中；蓋下後等下一回合。: Recovery only returns it to your hand. After Setting it, wait until the next turn.
用過的守門符還沒收回，哈拉的攻勢已朝神殿而來。莎爾瑪向阿努比斯攤開手。: Hala's assault was already approaching the temple before the used guardian talisman had returned. Salma opened her hand toward Anubis.

回到手裡，還不算門已經守好。剛才那一刻，才真正接上。: Having it back in my hand did not mean the door was safe yet. It was that last moment that brought our support together.
說出害怕，先備好接應: Admit your fear and prepare support
怕就告訴我。我把護符帶回來，妳把守門的準備做好。: If you are scared, tell me. I will bring the talisman back; you prepare to guard the door.
妳等到了攻勢真正靠近，沒有先把守門符用空。: You waited until the assault was truly close instead of using up the talisman early.
等護符佈好，再接攻勢: Prepare the talisman, then face the attack
讓符先回來、重新設下。到能發動的時候，我與妳一起接。: Bring the talisman back and Set it again first. Once it is ready to activate, we can face them together.
護符接上了，我們也守過了。: The talisman did its part, and we held through the attack too.
解放沙布提俑請荷魯斯2500，蓋神殿餘火；戰鬥開始以荷魯斯降攻500，擊破薩爾瓦: Tribute Shabti Figurine to Summon Horus with 2500 ATK, then Set Temple Embers. At the start of battle, use Horus to lower Salwa's ATK by 500, then defeat her in battle. Her original ATK is 2300.

神殿餘火只作蓋牌條件，這次不發動它。: Temple Embers is only needed as a Set card for the condition. Do not activate it this time.
薩爾瓦叫她撤掉後援，莎爾瑪差點把那當成證明勇氣的機會。她望見神殿裡還在等的人，停: Salwa told Salma to dismiss her support. Salma nearly took it as a chance to prove her courage, but seeing those still waiting inside the temple made her stop.
神殿餘火留在後方。荷魯斯，前面交給你，我把接應守好。: Temple Embers stays behind us. Horus, take the front. I will keep our support ready.

薩爾瓦的攻勢被削弱，荷魯斯突破赤沙。神殿餘火仍留在後方，沒有被急著用掉。: Salwa's assault weakened, and Horus broke through the red sand. Temple Embers stayed behind them, not spent in haste.
回去把名字簿攤開。我想請他們一起看，不再一個人守。: Let us go back and open the book of names. I want everyone to look with me, so I am not guarding it alone anymore.

妳把餘火留好，前面這段我接。後面的人也在出力。: Keep the embers ready. I will take this stretch ahead. Those behind us are helping too.
妳這次回頭找了援手。: This time, you turned back and asked for help.

讓他們守住後面。我有能突破的時機，不必大家一起衝。: Let them hold the rear. I have a chance to break through; not everyone needs to charge together.
後援還在，回來時我們也有地方站穩。: Our support is still there. We will have a steady place to return to.
回來的人可以先休息: Those Who Return May Rest First
解放貝斯與托特請伊西絲，讓棄牌區巴絲特守備回場；日輪照破另棄沙布提俑，破壞名字鎖: Tribute Bes and Thoth to Summon Isis, bringing Bastet from the Discard Pile in Defense Position. 名字鎖印借著熟悉的聲音催人向前，巴絲特卻還等著接回。莎爾瑪把手從鎖印上移開。: Name-Lock Seal urged them forward in a familiar voice, while Bastet still waited to return. Salma took her hand away from the seal.

妳先躺一會兒。這次沒有人叫妳立刻再戰。: Lie down for a while. This time, no one is asking you to fight again right away.
先把她接回來。這一步我往前，讓她喘勻。: Bring her back first. I will take this step forward; let her catch her breath.
妳留給她的是休息，沒有再加一道命令。: You gave her a rest, not another order.
妳備好照破鎖印，前面的守衛我處理。: Get ready to break the seal. I will deal with the guard ahead.
面具沒能把她再叫走。: The mask could not call her away again.
把記憶變成歸途: Turn Memory into a Way Home

偽名束縛對準巴絲特。莎爾瑪先把撤回的符設好，在圖上給她留出另一條歸路。: False Name Binding aimed at Bastet. Salma first prepared the retreat talisman and marked another way home for her on the map.
她指定妳，就先回來。伊西絲守這裡，等守衛能接，再讓妳站穩。: If she targets you, come back first. Isis will hold here. Once the guardian can receive you, you can take your place safely again.
好。先讓她離開術式的目標，別急著走回同一個位置。: Yes. Get her out of the Spell's target first. Do not rush her straight back into the same place.
巴絲特及時撤回，伊西絲守過攻勢。下一次，守衛才接她回到安全的位置。: Bastet withdrew in time, and Isis held through the attack. Only on the next turn did the guardian bring her back to a safe position.
這條路留得住。妳走回來時，我不用再伸手把妳拉住。: This way can stay open. When you come back along it, I will not need to reach out and hold you back.
承認害怕，仍先讓她撤下: Admit your fear, but let her withdraw first
先帶她離開術式。我守住這一陣，妳不用把害怕藏著。: Get her away from the Spell first. I will hold through this wave. You do not have to hide your fear.
妳還是怕，卻沒有把她留在危險裡。: You were still afraid, but you did not leave her in danger.

到守衛能接的時候再請她回來，準備與代價都別漏。: Ask her to return when the guardian can receive her. Do not skip the preparation or the cost.
她沿著留好的路回來，這次沒有急著省掉等待。: She came back along the path you kept. This time, you did not skip the wait.
讓同伴自己寫下明天: Let Your Companions Write Their Own Tomorrow

本回合只有一次通常出場，巴絲特不再通常出場。: You have only 1 Normal Summon this turn. Do not Normal Summon Bastet as well.
回收兩類資源各自結算；重新蓋的伏兵當回合不能使用。: Resolve the recovery of each resource type separately. You cannot use the newly Set Ambush this turn.
賽特的投影從名字簿最後一頁凝起，許諾她寫下永不改變的誓言，就歸還所有名字。: Set's projection formed from the last page of the book of names. It promised to return every name if Salma wrote an oath that would never change.
可他們明天想換路，我不能替他們簽。這一頁留白。: But if they want another path tomorrow, I cannot sign for them. This page stays blank.

守門的準備備好，歐西里斯突破赤沙。巴絲特仍留在神籙裡，莎爾瑪把筆交給歸來的人。: With their defenses ready, Osiris broke through the red sand. Bastet stayed inside Shenlu, and Salma handed the pen to those who had returned.
想讓我怎麼記住你？這一行，你自己寫。: How would you like me to remember you? Write this line yourself.
卡里姆送來日輪黑影的拓片，與門柱赤砂紋接合。她帶上兩片線索，去河岸與他會合。: Karim sent a rubbing of the sun disc's dark shadow, which joined with the red-sand marks on the doorpost. Salma took both clues to meet him by the river.
問她今天想怎麼被記住: Ask how she wants to be remembered today
先讓她休息。今天用不著另一場戰鬥來回答。: Let her rest first. She does not need another battle to answer that today.
她有時間想，也敢把現在的名字寫下。: She had time to think, and the courage to write the name she uses now.
把筆交還給她: Give the pen back to her
妳把筆放到她手邊，前面的赤沙我擋。: Put the pen beside her hand. I will hold back the red sand ahead.
空白還留著，她可以慢慢寫。: The blank space is still hers. She can take her time writing.
日輪的黑影與赤沙紋合在一起，賽特殘影纏上阿佩普投影，把出口一同遮住。兩人把線索攤: The sun disc's dark shadow joined with the red-sand marks. Set's afterimage coiled around Apep's projection, hiding the exit. The two laid their clues beside the book.
我請歐西里斯接回守門符，先守這一陣。巴絲特留著休息，你的力量等下一次再用。: I will ask Osiris to recover the guardian talisman so we can hold through this wave. Bastet can rest, and your strength can wait until next time.
好。拉神那份我留住，到能突破的時候，再付出需要的力量。: All right. I will save Ra's strength and only give what we need when it is time to break through.
守門符削弱賽特，歐西里斯守住反擊。下一次日輪升起，拉神才燃起力量，打散阿佩普纏成: The talisman weakened Set, and Osiris held and countered. Only when the sun disc rose again did Ra kindle his strength, scattering the chaotic projection tangled in Apep's coils.
筆我帶著。回去以後，先問他們想在哪裡停。: I have my pen. When we get back, I will first ask where they want to stop.
我還走得動。這回陪他們走完。: I can still walk. This time, I will stay with them all the way.

妳喊我的時候，留著的力量正好能用。: When you called me, the strength I had saved was ready to use.

她沒有被催著再戰，我們也都還走得動。: No one rushed her back into battle, and we can all still walk.
記住你的名字，也留下歸途: Remember Your Name, Leave a Way Home
